texts.preamble: Dharampal Satyapal Limited vs The State Of Jharkhand Through The Chief on 19 March, 2024 Author: Rajesh Kumar Bench: Rajesh Kumar -1- W.P.C No.3026 of 2021 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi W.P.(C) No.3026 of 2021 1. Dharampal Satyapal Limited, having its registered office at 98, Okhla Industrial Estate, Phase-III, P.O Okhla Industrial Estate Phase - Iii, New Delhi- 110020, P.S. Okhla Industrial Estate Phase - Iii, New Delhit, District-New Delhi through its Director, namely Pawan Kumar Goyal, aged about 54 years, S/o Late Shri Ram, R/o. I-1/33, Jai Mata Gali, Phase- 1, Budh Vihar, Sultanpuri, C-Block, North West Delhi-110086, P.O. Sultanpuri, P.S. Vijay Vihar. 2. Saroj Tradecom Private Limited, having its office at , J. J. Road, Upper Bazar, P.O G.P.O, P.S. - Kotwali, Town & District Ranchi (Jharkhand), through its Director, namely, Jay Prakash Singhania, aged about 43 years, son of Shri Bhagwati Prasad Singhania, P.O G.P.O, P.S. Kotwali, town & District Ranchi (Jharkhand) ...... Petitioners Versus 1. The State of Jharkhand through the Chief Secretary, Government of Jharkhand, Ranchi. 2. Principal Secretary -cum- Commissioner, Food Safety, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Jharkhand, Nepal House, Ranchi. 3. Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, through its Chief Executive Officer, F.D.A Bhawan, Kotla road, Near Bal Bhawan, New Delhi. ...... Respondents --------- Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar --------- For the Petitioners : Mr. Indrajit Sinha, Advocate Mrs. Prerna Jhunjhunwala, Advocate For the State : A.C to A.G --------- Dharampal Satyapal Limited vs The State Of Jharkhand Through The Chief on 19 March, 2024
